scope: Existing canonical Poaceae Bromus pubescens only: 1807/1809 accepted-author priority and the rejected B. purgans L. versus misapplied B. purgans auct. non L. boundary; preserve rank-specific previous evidence and photo/hybrid holds.

prior_evidence.note: 2026-10-23 three-species Bromus evidence already covers many historical purgans varieties; this record adds original Linnaean name versus misapplication and the 2009 accepted authorship correction.

decisions.reason: Accepted Poaceae species under POWO/WCVP; no canonical accepted-name change.
The 1807 Sprengel publication has priority over the 1809 Muhlenberg ex Willdenow attribution, as established by Veldkamp (2009) and adopted by POWO and USDA GRIN.
Canadian governmental nomenclature explicitly labels the later 1809 attribution an illegitimate isonym; do not create a separate learner or use this as the current accepted author.
Homotypic generic-combination synonym, not a second accepted species in the POWO backbone.
Heterotypic synonym; rank- and author-sensitive alias.
Kew places the original Linnaean rejected name under accepted B. kalmii, not B. pubescens.
Independently accepted species under POWO/WCVP; it is not an alias of the installed B. pubescens learner.

decisions.source_name: Bromus purgans var. laeviglumis (Scribn. ex Shear) Swallen
decisions.reason: Rank-qualified heterotypic synonym of B. pubescens, already covered in the prior cross-rank evidence.
Historical variety maps to separately accepted B. texensis, as documented in the prior cross-rank evidence.
Historical variety maps to separately accepted B. ciliatus, not B. pubescens or B. kalmii.

decisions.source_name: Proposal: map Bromus purgans L. directly to Bromus pubescens
decisions.reason: This conflates the Linnaean rejected name (under B. kalmii) with later misapplied usages (auct. non L.) that sometimes referred to B. pubescens.

decisions.source_name: Proposal: flatten all historical Bromus purgans ranks and forms into one learner
decisions.reason: Varieties and forms under the historical purgans complex belong to distinct modern accepted species; author/rank and voucher context must be retained.

decisions.source_name: Unqualified historical Bromus purgans auct. non L. observations
decisions.reason: The misapplied phrase has referred to B. pubescens and B. latiglumis; without author/rank, specimen or original source concept, do not assign an individual record to one accepted species.

decisions.source_name: Installed Bromus pubescens source-labelled photographs and individual specimens
decisions.reason: Accepted nomenclature and synonymy do not establish individual photographic or specimen identity; retain prior diagnostic-anatomy/source-voucher holds.
No primary evidence reviewed establishes a particular learner individual as a hybrid; do not infer ancestry from intermediate morphology.

decisions.source_name: Exact accession and herbarium particulars of Veldkamp's 2009 neotype
decisions.reason: The 2009 primary paper abstract confirms neotypification but the full protologue/typification details were not directly inspected during this run; do not invent voucher number, locality or repository.

sources_primary.authority: Veldkamp, J.F. 2009. The authorship of Bromus pubescens (Gramineae). Journal of the Torrey Botanical Society 136(1):137–138.
sources_primary.access: Published abstract verified; full article not inspected; neotype details remain UNRESOLVED.
B. purgans L. rejected name under B. kalmii

Historical B. purgans misapplication across accepted species

limitations: No new specimen/photo identification, hybrid validation, or county-native determination; original 2009 paper full text not inspected. Do not treat historical B. purgans auct. non L. as a formal homotypic synonym or silently rewrite source labels.

preservation.scientific_pass_fail_hold_unresolved: All prior decisions unchanged; new evidence appended as separate narrow record
